Exoplanets

Analyzing VLTI/GRAVITY Data of Beta Pictoris b for Exomoon-Induced Exoplanetary Wobble

A search for an exomoon signal in the tiny astrometric motion of a directly imaged exoplanet.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record

Galactic center

Investigating the Origins of the Fermi Bubbles with CMHD Simulations

A simulation-based comparison of two explanations for the enormous bipolar structures above and below the Milky Way.

Available: Poster · tjSTAR record

Radio transients

V-SPARC: Detecting Long-Period Transients with VLITE

A search of archival low-frequency radio observations for rare sources that pulse on minute-to-hour timescales.

Available: Paper · Poster · tjSTAR record
